title: Get ready it’s loud!
text: Get ready it’s loud!. It’ll get you up 4 sure!

product_metadata.title: Peakeep Retro 4 inches Battery Operated Twin Bell Loud Alarm Clock (Black with Arabic)
features: -A perfect combination of classical twin bell design and retro rustic distressed Roman numerals clock face, add incomparable decoration and practicability to your nightstand.
-Super loud alarm clock for people who are heavy sleepers, mild loss hearing even deaf. No snooze button, good wake up clock for people who has trouble waking up.
-Silent with non-ticking hands, nice for soothing sleep and guarantee better accuracy of time.
-Light only comes on demand, hold the light button, time will be clearly visible at night.
-Run by 1 AA battery (not included), quartz movement analog alarm clock, easy to use and set.
